topics.title: Movement, locomotion and types of cellular movement

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish movement from locomotion and give the purposes of locomotion.
Identify amoeboid, ciliary and muscular movements shown by human cells.
State the origin and the special properties of muscle tissue.
Compare skeletal, visceral and cardiac muscles by location, appearance and control.

topics.title: Structure of skeletal muscle and contractile proteins

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the organisation of a skeletal muscle into fascicles, fibres and myofibrils.
Identify the A band, I band, Z line, M line and H zone of a sarcomere.
Describe the structure of actin and myosin filaments and their regulatory proteins.
Explain the sequence of events from a neural signal to cross bridge formation.
Explain contraction as sliding of thin filaments and its effect on the bands.
Distinguish red and white muscle fibres and explain muscle fatigue.
State the composition and the axial and appendicular divisions of the human skeleton.
Describe the vertebral column, sternum and the types of ribs.
Identify the bones of the limbs and the pectoral and pelvic girdles.
Classify joints as fibrous, cartilaginous and synovial with examples.
Match types of synovial joints with their locations in the body.

topics.title: Disorders of muscular and skeletal system

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the causes and features of myasthenia gravis, muscular dystrophy and tetany.
Identify the causes and features of arthritis, osteoporosis and gout.
